patch_description:
The original pipeline loop used a batch approach: submit N reads, wait for ALL N to complete, then copy all to GPU. This serializes I/O and GPU DMA, resulting in low throughput and high latency.

The fix converts the pipeline loop to a true sliding-window approach: as each individual NVMe read completes, immediately start the GPU DMA copy for that chunk and submit the next NVMe read. This overlaps SSD I/O with GPU transfers, significantly improving throughput and reducing latency. Also increased PIPELINE_RING_SIZE to 16 for deeper queue depth.
